resources.string: Paste the invite link you were sent. If you have been in this room before on this phone, its address on its own is enough.
Put the room\'s address in first.
It has to be an https address. A browser only gives the microphone to a secure page, so a plain http room could be read but never talked in.
That doesn\'t look like a web address.
Holding the call. Tap to come back.
Voice Room needs the microphone to put you in a room.
